checks: 19 exact native tests twice debug/release; repeated syntax; three compiled source mutants
cost: For n frames, repeated bounded ancestor walks and scans give conservative O(n^3) plus output bytes; postprocessing BTree grouping O(R log R) plus cloning clauses. Full extract adds parser/model initialization and external data work not measured here.
description: Frame-to-rule construction and address-local exception/dispute postprocessing.
forward: force_of prioritizes copular attributes/guilt, passive lexical markers then modal sanctions. rules_of returns empty for question text; bounded parent walks assign deontic ownership/authority and separate acts, conditional OR groups, exception AND groups and reasons. extract initializes annotator, resets Ctx on address change, uses matching normalized DB text else parser, then attaches adjacent but-if and marks disputes.
inverse: Excluded under admitted frame indices: question text yielding rules, conditional/irrealis frame chosen as deontic root, or but-if attachment across different source addresses. Parser/resource failures and malformed foreign frames remain outside executed evidence.

A Rule list admits any frames/text carrying the selected force, clauses, authority and address projection after pruning; omitted manner, lexical surface and empty copulas produce nonunique fibers. A zero list can mean question, no deontic roots, or roots pruned empty.

First matching copular attr wins before modal. Positive must-pay sanction gives Liability, negative must gives Prohibition, may gives Permission unless negated. No modal/lexical marker yields None; order is not a commutative set reduction.

parent rejects self/out-of-range, while longer cycles terminate after steps>n. Nearest deontic ancestor owns subordinate frames; purpose frames under a parent are excluded from roots but retained as reasons where selected.

For adjacent rules with equal source, different sent and next text beginning but if/when, append one exception containing only first clause of each nonempty condition group. Alternative clauses beyond first are lost; not logical negation of the next rule.

Only addresses with at least4 dot segments and an act verb group by first3 segments+verb. Mark entire group iff distinct authority count>=2 and distinct(force,penalty) count>=2; no check pairs those differences within one authority pair.
limitations: Partial source-derived models and finite correspondence only
No live parser/corpus/frozen gold or protocol filesystem effects; no percentage surrogate
